title: Pollock on tomato and butter beans

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain kitchen staple, and vegetable stock and tinned butter beans are both allowed.

supermarket.reason: Pollock fillets, butter beans, tomatoes and spinach are everyday items in any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a wide lidded pan, and gently steaming fish on top of a sauce is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: The quantities suit four, the liquid is sensible for a bean base and 6 to 8 minutes covered will cook the pollock through.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes of prep covers slicing the onion and garlic and chopping 600g of tomatoes, and the steps add up to roughly 30 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A light tomato and bean pot with basil suits early June, and the tomatoes cook down to form the base of the dish rather than garnishing it.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, beans, tomatoes and spinach make a filling, balanced meal a family would happily eat.
